recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white composition featuring large-scale, interlocking geometric arcs and circles with a heavy, distressed photocopy or screen-print texture. The layout uses bold negative space and rough-edged typography to create a raw, industrial aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Interplay between solid black shapes and textured white negative space
Contrast between smooth geometric curves and jagged, distressed internal textures
Tension between the large-scale background shapes and small-scale corner typography
Horizontal scan-line artifacts within black fields against vertical paper grain
coreInvariants: Strict binary black and white palette
Heavy grit and speckle texture across all surfaces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, cropped circular forms dominate the frame, extending beyond the edges to create an abstract, zoomed-in perspective.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white arc in the center-right serves as the primary visual anchor, dividing the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the sweeping curves of the arcs from the bottom left to the top right, punctuated by the text in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Negative space is used actively as a shape itself, particularly the white textured areas that define the boundaries of the black circles.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mid-tone grays created through stippling and scan-line textures
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between pure black and textured white.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Handwritten sans-serif with irregular stroke widths
letterConstructionRules: Rounded terminals with slight ink bleed
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' features a curved, almost lowercase-style spine
The 'A' has a high, slanted crossbar
The '6' is tightly coiled with a heavy bottom loop

composition.position: top right and bottom right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style hand-lettering used for all text elements to maintain a unified 'journal' or 'sketchbook' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, immediate feel of the original lettering
Matches the distressed, high-contrast DIY aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white abstract composition featuring large, overlapping circular shapes and arcs. Apply a heavy photocopy texture with horizontal scan lines in the black areas and fine dust/grit in the white areas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn, thick marker-style text in the top right and bottom right corners. The text should be solid black with slightly irregular, jittery edges to match the distressed background.

verificationChecks: Is the palette strictly black and white?
Are there visible scan-line textures in the black shapes?
Is the typography placed in the corners?
Does the composition feel zoomed-in and abstract?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the horizontal scan lines
Curvature and scale of the geometric arcs
mustRedesign: Unique glyph shapes of the custom lettering
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no gray tones except through texture
Verify text is legible but raw
Confirm texture is consistent across the frame
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Large Geometric Arcs] + [Photocopy Scan-line Texture] + [Corner-aligned Marker Lettering] + [Binary Black/White Palette].
